meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year passes through three stages: the budget estimate (February before the year), the revised estimate (February of the year) and the accounts (provisional in May after the year, audited later). The RBI's tables restate a year as it moves from one stage to the next; each stage is kept as its own series.

table.title: Gross capital formation from budgetary resources of the Central Government (discontinued)

meta.coverage: What the Centre's budget built or paid others to build, ₹ crore, 1970-71 to 2017-18 (the table ends there)
meta.note: RBI, Gross capital formation from budgetary resources of the Central Government (discontinued) (DBIE report 350; Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy). Amounts in ₹ crore (DBIE serves rupees). From the Ministry of Finance's Economic and Functional Classification of the Central Government Budget; the RBI stopped the table at 2017-18 (BE). The RBI discontinued this table after 2017-18. Cross-checked against the printed table (Innovation Hub export of Handbook report 77): 432 of 432 figures match.
